name: Willys MB jeep (pintle M2 .50)
identity: Variant of the supplied Willys MB model with a pedestal M2 .50 between the front seats: the supplied mesh has no gun mount, so the post is a plain added cylinder and the gun is the game's M2HB model (m2hb_carry). Windshield folded for the field of fire, stowage kept.

variant.note: type 3: Ctrl moves the driver to the gun (the car holds on its handbrake)
